description: Monthly revenue · USD thousands. June revenue is up 17.9% over May.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Revenue momentum” with the muted eyebrow “Monthly revenue · USD thousands”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Plot Jan–Jun revenue values 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, and 368 in USD thousands as a smooth natural curve with a 2px stroke and a faint 16% area fill. Show $368k as the headline and a footer noting June revenue is up 17.9% over May.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, subtle horizontal grid lines, and muted axis labels and baselines.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
